description: OpenGGCM models magnetosphere-ionosphere interactions using magnetohydrodynamics and electrodynamic coupling. Its development extends earlier magnetosphere simulations with improved treatment of the ionospheric boundary. The resource is documented by University of New Hampshire. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented lack of energetic-particle drift and ring-current physics limits inner-magnetosphere results. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded.
